content: This topic was moved to #job postings > PhD positions at Nottingham by Johan Commelin.

We have several PhD positions at Nottingham which includes the FP lab specializing in functional programming, type theory, category theory and formal proof.

If you are interested please contact me. If you know somebody who may be interested, please spread the word. 

See the webpage for an overview over the team and a link to the ad.

https://people.cs.nott.ac.uk/pszgmh/10-phds.html

Cheers,

Thorsten
